headline: Mod installs and save safeguards land while Going Commando matching advances
summary: OpenRAC Development gains dependency-aware mod installs, updates with rollback, consistent diagonal movement and Windows audio fixes; installation changes still need Windows, macOS and Android testing (OpenRAC#161). Stable receives a direct PAL level 11 lighting fix rather than its usual release PR (OpenRAC#189), while Mod SDK 1.11.0 ships. Archipelago v2.1.0 protects saves from the wrong room, Difficulty v1.2.4 restores Blarg Station's ship and Clank, and Item Randomizer v1.0.4 also releases; players can help test item logic in openrac-mods#25. Going Commando's final reported matched code reaches 84.74%, while Ratchet & Clank retains complete code matching through source cleanup and Deadlocked gains PAL reconstructions. Co-op and Going Commando's native port remain drafts; the latter is not yet playable (OpenRAC#166, OpenRAC#191).
